statement: xpadneo uses model matching plus optional per-device quirks and heuristics influenced by the original HID identity, descriptor length and Bluetooth metadata; those flags can disable trigger rumble or pulse parameters and alter motor masking. Therefore a working Series reference profile is not necessarily representative of every third-party controller sharing an Xbox-style identifier.

applicability.revision: standard Series model 1914, comparisons explicitly scoped to other models
applicability.firmware: not physically measured; source version is pinned
applicability.scope: quirks.c:14-29,45-69,70-200; xpadneo.h:30-53; rumble.c:83-136. No Bluetooth addresses or quirk identities reproduced.
